frozen_before: full 8-policy d1_d3_d7_summary.json exists (only D7 seed 3200001 board is complete)

partial_board_at_freeze.permitted_use: motivates the opponent-difficulty vs specialization questions; does NOT classify Path A or Path B

scientific_question: Does strategic opponent diversity in this maritime CTF change difficulty for one PPO generalist, or create complementary best responses?

PATH_A.title: PPO absorbs strategic diversity into a robust generalist
PATH_A.condition: no credible ranking crossover on the completed 8-policy board
PATH_A.permitted_claim: Opponent identity mostly changes difficulty; D1/D3/D7 fingerprints are similar enough that an explicit repertoire is not justified by this matrix.
PATH_A.prohibited_claim: specialization is impossible; latents cannot work; D7 is proven more robust unless the D1/D3/D7 robustness comparison is also reported as OBSERVED
PATH_A.next: do not auto-train a specialist population; optional 1-seed specialist pilot only if explicitly authorized

PATH_B.title: Strategic opponent diversity creates complementary best responses
PATH_B.condition: CROSSOVER_FOUND between DIFFERENT diversity_conditions (not same-condition seed pairs)
PATH_B.permitted_claim: Different policy responses matter against different opponents on this board.
PATH_B.prohibited_claim: latent demand is established; a selector will work; a full multi-seed repertoire is required
PATH_B.next: 1-seed specialist pilot (SEED_PROTOCOL_FROZEN.json), still a human scientific boundary

CROSSOVER_FOUND.definition: There exist policies A,B and opponents X,Y such that A beats B on X and B beats A on Y, with uncertainty excluding zero in both directions.
CROSSOVER_FOUND.estimator: per-cell win rate, n=30 episodes; two-proportion Wald 95% CI on WR(A)-WR(B) using the cell n; LCB95 > 0 required in both directions
CROSSOVER_FOUND.does_not_require: every policy specializes; action-distribution differences; a specific opponent pair chosen after seeing the heatmap
CROSSOVER_FOUND.search: all unordered policy pairs among the 8 PRIMARY rows, all opponent pairs OP6-OP12

PATH_B_requires_cross_condition.recorded_before: any D1 or D3 evaluation row exists; 15/56 cells collected, two D7 boards complete
PATH_B_requires_cross_condition.rule: Same-condition seed pairs (D7 vs D7, D1 vs D1, D3 vs D3) may produce Wald crossovers; report those as SEED_NOISE. They do NOT classify PATH_B.
PATH_B_requires_cross_condition.PATH_B_trigger: at least one Wald two-way crossover between policies from DIFFERENT diversity_conditions (D1 vs D3, D1 vs D7, or D3 vs D7)
PATH_B_requires_cross_condition.why: D7-3200001 vs D7-3200002 already shows large same-condition cell movement (OP7 .867 vs .600). That is PPO seed fingerprint variance, not evidence that opponent diversity created specialization.
PATH_B_requires_cross_condition.does_not_change: Wald LCB95>0 estimator; multiplicity caveat; discovery-vs-confirmation hierarchy

report: per-opponent mean WR across policies (column means)
per-policy Spearman correlation of its opponent-WR vector with the column-mean ranking
opponent_difficulty_vs_specialization.interpretation: If worst-opponent identity is shared and rank correlations are high, columns describe opponents. This is supporting description for Path A, not a second independent gate.

diversity_value_D1_D3_D7.aggregation: mean across available seeds per condition (D3 uses completed seeds only: 3700001, 3700002)
diversity_value_D1_D3_D7.label: OBSERVED
diversity_value_D1_D3_D7.interesting_but_not_required_for_PATH_A: D1 ≈ D3 ≈ D7 in average WR, with D7 lower matchup variance and better worst-case
diversity_value_D1_D3_D7.inherits_VGC_outcomes: artifacts/vgc_diversity/VGC_DIVERSITY_SETS_FROZEN.json outcomes A-F remain valid publishable diversity-scaling results independent of Path B

specialist_decision.PATH_A: STOP population. Do not launch S_OP7/S_OP12 unless explicitly authorized as a 1-seed exploratory probe.
specialist_decision.PATH_B: 1-seed specialist pilot is the minimum next experiment; not a 3-seed grid.

latent_collapse_explanation.if_PATH_A: D1/D3/D7 converging to similar fingerprints is supporting explanation for why z collapsed — the board may not reward distinct strategies strongly enough. Supporting, not a causal proof.
latent_collapse_explanation.if_PATH_B: do not use generalist-absorption as the latent-collapse story

immutability: After d1_d3_d7_summary.json exists, do not change CROSSOVER_FOUND, Path A/B conditions, or specialist_decision to flatter the observed matrix.

multiplicity_caveat_recorded_before_rema.statement: The Path A/B classifier scans all PRIMARY policy-pair × opponent-pair combinations. A Wald LCB95>0 on each comparison does not control family-wise false-positive rate across that scan.
multiplicity_caveat_recorded_before_rema.how_to_label_a_PATH_B_hit: preregistered DISCOVERY result, not a confirmatory demonstration of a specific matchup tradeoff
multiplicity_caveat_recorded_before_rema.confirmation: If PATH_B, the subsequent 1-seed specialist pilot / targeted confirmatory evaluation tests that discovered crossover again. Do not retune the matrix gate to make discovery stricter or looser after seeing the board.

discovery_vs_confirmation_hierarchy.3a_no_crossover: PATH_A — generalist absorption; stop specialist population
discovery_vs_confirmation_hierarchy.4_if_PATH_B: targeted 1-seed specialist pilot, then confirm the exact matchup tradeoff
